Use image1 as opening frame — CUPID left, DEATH right. Full reactive fighting game HUD: yellow health bar left, green health bar right, animated portraits, combo counters, damage sparks, ROUND 1 center, SUPER bars bottom. Health bars MUST dynamically decrease with every successful hit, block damage, projectile impact, and ultimate attack. Visible stagger animations, hit reactions, particle effects, cinematic impact flashes, and environmental destruction. Ultra-photorealistic cinematic. Dark fantasy Mortal Kombat style. 16:9 widescreen.

Arena: A ruined gothic cathedral fused with a cursed underworld necropolis beneath a giant blood moon. Broken angel statues, burning candles, black roses scattered across wet marble floors, skull piles, fog rolling across the ground, moonlight piercing shattered arches. Romantic but horrifying atmosphere. Wet reflective surfaces. Cinematic volumetric lighting.

CHARACTERS:

* CUPID (left): Beautiful angelic youth with curly golden hair, white feathered wings, soft glowing skin, flowing ivory silk cloth, golden bow with heart-shaped arrows. Uses love magic, radiant arrows, pink energy blasts, rose petal storms, divine light, and heavenly wing attacks.
* DEATH (right): Tall skeletal grim reaper in torn black robes, glowing skull eyes, giant cursed scythe. Uses shadow magic, soul-drain powers, black smoke, skeletal summons, cursed chains, and death energy.

SHOT 1 (00:00–00:01) — ROUND 1 Start.
Massive gothic gold “ROUND 1” text ignites center screen. Voice: “ROUND ONE. FIGHT!” Camera rockets violently through fog, candles, ash, and rose petals toward both fighters. HUD powers on with glowing animations. Health bars full.

SHOT 2 (00:01–00:04) — DIRECT COMBAT.
CUPID launches forward mid-air, firing rapid glowing heart arrows. First arrow pierces DEATH’S shoulder — HUGE IMPACT FLASH. DEATH health bar drops 10%. Black smoke erupts from the wound.

DEATH instantly teleports through shadow mist and swings his giant scythe horizontally across CUPID’S chest. Dark energy explodes outward — CUPID health bar drops 15%. Feathers and rose petals burst across the screen.

CUPID spins backward in the air and unleashes a radiant wing slash directly into DEATH’S ribcage. Sparks, bones, and cursed smoke explode outward. DEATH health bar drops another 12%.

Camera performs aggressive 360° orbit around both fighters. Every successful strike causes dynamic HUD shake, combo counters, cinematic hit-stop, damage numbers, and visible health reduction. SLOW MOTION 20% during all heavy impacts — feathers, black smoke, glowing arrows, and shattered marble flying across the arena.

SHOT 3 (00:04–00:07) — SPECIAL ABILITIES.
CUPID rises into the sky surrounded by divine pink light and summons a MASSIVE STORM OF HEART ARROWS raining downward across the battlefield. DEATH blocks partially with a spinning scythe barrier but still takes heavy chip damage. DEATH health bar rapidly drops to 45%.

DEATH slams his scythe into the ground and summons giant skeletal hands erupting from beneath the cathedral floor, grabbing CUPID’S legs and wings. Shadow chains wrap around him while souls scream in the background. CUPID health bar drains rapidly to 40%.

DEATH unleashes a giant wave of black death fog consuming half the arena. CUPID counters with a radiant explosion of golden love energy and rose petals. Camera ECU: glowing pink divine light colliding against black smoke and screaming souls. SUPER meters charging rapidly with every hit.

SHOT 4 (00:07–00:10) — TITAN CLASH.
CUPID summons a GIGANTIC CELESTIAL ANGEL made of radiant gold light and endless wings. DEATH summons a MASSIVE SHADOW REAPER TITAN emerging from beneath the necropolis.

SLOW MOTION 15%: both titans charge across the battlefield. Angelic spear collides with gigantic cursed scythe center screen. Massive HUD warnings flash during impact.

Explosive collision of holy light, black smoke, feathers, souls, cursed fire, and shattered cathedral debris erupts outward. Both fighters caught inside the blast wave.

CUPID health bar drops from 40% to 5%.
DEATH health bar drops from 45% to 3%.

HUD enters CRITICAL state — flashing red warning lights, cracked UI, distorted sound effects, low-health heartbeat audio.

Camera RUSHES directly into the explosion of divine light and darkness.

SHOT 5 (00:13–00:15) — EPIC DRAW.
Both fighters violently slammed into opposite cathedral pillars. Entire arena collapsing beneath the blood moon. Ash, black feathers, rose petals, broken skulls, smoke, and debris everywhere.

CUPID struggles to stand as his glowing wings slowly fade.
DEATH’S skeletal body cracks apart while shadow smoke leaks from inside his robes.

Final delayed damage ticks activate simultaneously.

CUPID health bar empties completely.
DEATH health bar empties completely.

LOUD announcer voice: “DOUBLE K.O.”

FREEZE FRAME. Giant burning gothic gold text: “EPIC DRAW”.

Camera slow cinematic orbit through smoke, feathers, and drifting rose petals as the HUD glitches and fades out.

Hard cut to black.
